    Icons that know
    what they are for.

    Drawn from scratch on a 24 grid — nothing traced, nothing re-licensed. Five weights and five animations generated from one geometry, so bold can never drift away from line. Take any icon at any size, in any colour, as SVG, PNG or JPG.

    Draw needs a stroke to draw, so it does nothing on the solid weight.

    Nothing matches that. Every icon is named for what it is, not what it does — try circle-check rather than success.

    Take it three ways

    All three are the same geometry. Pick whichever suits the project — nothing here needs a build step.

    The sprite

    One request for the whole set, then reference an icon by name. Both files are served from icons.imswarnil.com.

    <link rel="stylesheet"
      href="…/swarnil-icons.css">

<svg class="ic ic-lg">
  <use href="…/sprite.svg#i-camera"/>
</svg>

    The package

    The source SVGs, the sprite, the JSON index and both stylesheets.

    npm i @imswarnil/swarnil-icons

import icons from
  '@imswarnil/swarnil-icons'
// …/css   …/motion   …/sprite

    Colour and motion

    Colour reads your design system's --accent if you have one, and falls back to ours if you do not.

    ic-primary              brand colour
ic-solid ic-primary     filled with it
ic-multi ic-multi-fill  three colours
ic-draw-in              draws itself on

    Motion

    This icon has no solid variant — its paths are open, and a filled open path is a blob rather than an icon. A solid needs its own declared geometry.
